repos.description: LLM API 管理 & 分发系统，支持 OpenAI、Azure、Anthropic Claude、Google Gemini、DeepSeek、字节豆包、ChatGLM、文心一言、讯飞星火、通义千问、360 智脑、腾讯混元等主流模型，统一 API 适配，可用于 key 管理与二次分发。单可执行文件，提供 Docker 镜像，一键部署，开箱即用。LLM API management & key redistribution system, unifying multiple providers under a single API. Single binary, Docker-ready, with an English UI.
repos.summary_zh: One API 是一个统一的 LLM API 管理与分发系统，支持 OpenAI、Azure、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、文心一言等数十家主流大模型，通过标准 OpenAI API 格式统一接入，实现密钥管理、负载均衡与二次分发。提供单可执行文件部署、Docker 镜像及英文 Web UI，开箱即用，适用于企业级多模型集成场景。
repos.summary_en: One API is a unified LLM API management and distribution system that supports over 20 mainstream models including OpenAI, Azure, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Baidu's Wenxin. It standardizes access via OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling key management, load balancing, and redistribution. Deployable as a single binary or Docker image with an English web interface, it offers out-of-the-box functionality for enterprise multi-model integration.

repos.description: Simple and easy to use DDNS. Support Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Dnspod, Cloudflare, Callback, Huawei Cloud, Baidu Cloud, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Namecheap, NameSilo...
repos.summary_zh: DDNS-GO 是一款轻量级动态域名解析服务工具，支持多平台（Mac/Windows/Linux）及主流云服务商（阿里云、腾讯云、Cloudflare等），自动获取公网 IPv4/IPv6 地址并更新对应域名记录。具备网页配置界面、日志查看、Webhook 通知、多级域名解析和自定义参数传递功能，支持 Docker 部署与系统服务化运行。
repos.summary_en: DDNS-GO is a lightweight dynamic DNS tool supporting multiple platforms (Mac/Windows/Linux) and cloud providers (Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Cloudflare, etc.). It automatically fetches public IPv4/IPv6 addresses and updates domain records via a web-based interface. Features include multi-domain support, Webhook notifications, custom parameters, Docker deployment, and system service integration.

repos.description: 🚀 Next Gen Multi-tenant AI One-Stop Solution. Builtin Admin & Billing System. Enterprise-Grade Unified LLM Gateway Support for 200+ Models And 35+ Providers, Load Balacing w/ Priority-base Routing, Cost Management, Chat Share, Cloud Sync, Credit/Subscription Billing, All File Parsing, Web Search, Built-in Model Cache.
repos.summary_zh: CoAI.Dev 是一款企业级多租户 AI 一站式解决方案，支持 200+ 模型与 35+ 服务商接入，内置统一 LLM 网关、负载均衡、成本管理与订阅计费系统。具备跨平台 UI、文件解析、Web 搜索、PWA 桌面应用及完整后台管理功能，适用于企业私有化部署与商业化运营。
repos.summary_en: CoAI.Dev is a next-generation multi-tenant AI platform offering unified access to 200+ models across 35+ providers, with built-in billing, load balancing, file parsing, web search, and enterprise-grade admin dashboard. Designed for scalable SaaS deployment and commercial AI service delivery.

repos.description: 专注批量推送的小而美的工具，目前支持：模板消息-公众号、模板消息-小程序、微信客服消息、微信企业号/企业微信消息、阿里云短信、阿里大于模板短信 、腾讯云短信、云片网短信、E-Mail、HTTP请求、钉钉、华为云短信、百度云短信、又拍云短信、七牛云短信
repos.summary_zh: WePush 是一款专注于批量消息推送的轻量级工具，支持微信公众号、小程序、企业微信、短信平台（阿里云、腾讯云等）及邮件等多种渠道。具备变量消息、定时推送、用户导入、多账号管理等功能，提供可视化界面与推送历史管理，适用于营销通知、系统告警等场景。
repos.summary_en: WePush is a lightweight tool for bulk message pushing, supporting WeChat official accounts, mini-programs, enterprise accounts, SMS platforms (e.g., Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud), and email. It offers variable messaging, scheduled delivery, user import, multi-account management, and a user-friendly GUI, ideal for marketing alerts and system notifications.

repos.description: 基于大模型的智能对话客服工具，支持微信、拼多多、千牛、哔哩哔哩、抖音企业号、抖音、抖店、微博聊天、小红书专业号运营、小红书、知乎等平台接入，可选择 GPT3.5/GPT4.0/ 懒人百宝箱 （后续会支持更多平台），能处理文本、语音和图片，通过插件访问操作系统和互联网等外部资源，支持基于自有知识库定制企业 AI 应用。
repos.summary_zh: 金销数据云智能客服是基于大语言模型的专业电商SaaS解决方案，支持微信、拼多多、千牛、抖音、小红书等10+主流平台接入，具备文本/语音/图片处理能力，支持自有知识库定制与插件扩展，提供多维度数据分析与意图识别功能。
repos.summary_en: JinXiao Data Cloud AI Customer Service is a professional e-commerce SaaS solution powered by large language models, supporting integration with 10+ mainstream platforms including WeChat, Pinduoduo, Qianniu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, with capabilities for text/voice/image processing, custom knowledge base configuration, plugin ecosystem, and multi-dimensional data analytics including intent recognition.

repos.description: Modern photo gallery for photographers, with S3/GitHub sync, EXIF details, maps, and a WebGL viewer.
repos.summary_zh: Afilmory 是一款专为摄影师打造的高性能现代照片画廊平台，支持 S3/GitHub 同步、EXIF 元数据展示、地理地图可视化和 WebGL 渲染，提供响应式瀑布流布局和国际化支持，适用于自建或 SaaS 部署。
repos.summary_en: Afilmory is a modern, high-performance photo gallery platform for photographers, featuring S3/GitHub sync, EXIF metadata, interactive maps, and WebGL rendering. Built with React + TypeScript, it offers responsive masonry layouts, multi-storage support, and HDR/Live Photo compatibility for professional photo curation.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Azure 语音服务的现代化 TTS 服务，采用 Go + React 前后端分离架构，支持多语言、可调节语速语调、OpenAI API 兼容及 Docker/Cloudflare Worker 多部署方式，提供高性能文本转语音能力。
repos.summary_en: A modern Text-to-Speech service built on Microsoft Azure Speech Services, featuring a Go+React separation architecture with multi-language support, adjustable rate/pitch/style, OpenAI API compatibility, and flexible deployment via Docker or Cloudflare Workers.

repos.description: TTS Azure Web 是一个 Azure 文本转语音（TTS）网页应用，可以在本地或者云端使用你的 Azure Key 一键部署。TTS Azure Web is an Azure Text-to-Speech (TTS) web application. It allows you to run it locally or deploy it with a single click using your Azure Key.
repos.summary_zh: TTS Azure Web 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 React 19 的 Azure 文本转语音（TTS）网页应用，支持 SSML 精细调优、多语言语音定制及一键部署。提供 Normal/SSML 双模式切换、音频参数调节与导出功能，适用于快速集成 Azure TTS 能力至本地或云端环境。
repos.summary_en: TTS Azure Web is a Next.js 15 and React 19-based web application for Azure Text-to-Speech (TTS), enabling fine-grained voice control via SSML. It supports dual-mode operation (UI/SSML), audio export, and one-click deployment with Azure credentials, ideal for rapid integration of Azure TTS into local or cloud environments.

repos.summary_zh: Next Money 是一个基于 Next.js 14 的全栈 SaaS 启动模板，集成 Stripe 支付、Clerk 认证、Supabase 数据库、React Email 和 Shadcn/ui 等现代技术栈，专为快速构建商业化 SaaS 产品而设计，提供完整的用户管理、支付处理与邮件通知解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Next Money is a full-stack SaaS starter template built with Next.js 14, integrating Stripe payments, Clerk authentication, Supabase database, React Email, and Shadcn/ui. It accelerates SaaS development with ready-to-use user management, payment processing, and email notification features.

repos.description: A multi-model AI Telegram bot powered by Cloudflare Workers, supporting various APIs including OpenAI, Claude, and Azure. Developed in TypeScript with a modular design for easy expansion.基于 Cloudflare Workers 的多模型 AI Telegram 机器人，支持 OpenAI、Claude、Azure 等多个 API，采用 TypeScript 开发，模块化设计便于扩展。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的多模型 AI Telegram 机器人，支持 OpenAI、Claude、Azure 等多个 API，采用 TypeScript 开发，模块化设计便于扩展。具备智能对话、图像生成与分析、多语言支持等功能，通过 Redis 缓存提升性能，适用于构建高效可扩展的 AI 聊天服务。
repos.summary_en: A multi-model AI Telegram bot built with TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, supporting APIs from OpenAI, Claude, Azure, and more. Features modular architecture for easy expansion, including intelligent conversation, image generation/analysis, multilingual support, and Redis caching for high-performance deployment.
